title: E-Administration: Ügyfélkapu, Algorithmic Decision-Making and Rights

sections.title: The Structural Mechanism
sections.content: Hungary has shifted toward comprehensive e-administration: the *Ügyfélkapu* (Client Gate) and the *Digitális Állampolgárság Program (DÁP)* have replaced physical paper queues with encrypted online portals.

sections.title: Rhetorical Application & Stance
sections.content: Digital administration brings immense efficiency, but also novel legal challenges: algorithmic bias, cybersecurity vulnerabilities, and the *digitális szakadék* (digital divide) affecting the elderly and rural populations.
